permissions.name: kempo-inventory-barcodes:manage
permissions.description: Change the label and sheet sizes, see and delete everyone's print sheets, and adopt existing SKUs as barcodes

groups.name: kempo-inventory-barcodes:admin
groups.description: Can set up barcode labels and manage everyone's print sheets

settings.name: sheet_width
settings.description: Paper width in inches. US Letter is 8.5, A4 is 8.27.

settings.name: sheet_height
settings.description: Paper height in inches. US Letter is 11, A4 is 11.69.

settings.name: sheet_margin
settings.description: Blank space around the edge of the paper, in inches. Most printers cannot print closer than 0.25 to the edge.

settings.name: label_width
settings.description: Width of one label in inches. As many labels as fit across the paper are printed on each row.

settings.name: label_height
settings.description: Height of one label in inches. As many rows as fit down the paper are printed.

settings.name: label_gap
settings.description: Space between labels in inches. Leave at 0 to cut along shared lines; use a little more if you cut each label out separately.

settings.name: label_text
settings.description: Print the item's name above the barcode on new print sheet entries. Each entry can still turn it on or off.

settings.name: label_text_size
settings.description: Size of the item name on a label, in points.

settings.name: label_cut_guides
settings.description: Draw a thin outline around every label so it is easy to cut out.

settings.name: internal_prefix
settings.description: Start of the codes made up for items that have no barcode, such as INV-000123. Capital letters and numbers only.
